scope: Read-only audit of official inference and metrics; no new model evaluation performed by this audit.

input.centroid: masks_centroid uint8/255, used directly for connected components

metrics.target_hit: any positive prediction in 3x3 neighborhood of any centroid-component pixel
metrics.false_count: positive pixels outside union of 9x9 neighborhoods of centroid-component pixels
metrics.border_slicing: unaltered Python slices; no explicit clipping
metrics.aggregate_pd: sum TrueNumAll / sum TgtNumAll, not average per-sequence Pd
metrics.auc: sklearn.metrics.auc(Fa, Pd), unmodified full sampled curve; no clipping, no normalization, no inserted endpoints
metrics.iou: global sum intersection / global sum union, not mean per-frame or per-class IoU

reference_results_origin: Bundled author eval.txt dated 2025-06-16; these are author reference values, not locally rerun results.

paper_v5.low_snr_auc_explanation: Table VIII has no low-SNR AUC column; all-test AUC0.9978 must not be assigned to low-SNR.

execution_notes: Keep source sequence order when calling writeNUDTMIRSDT_ROC; hardcoded subgroup indices are order-sensitive.
Use batch_size=1: sequence stitching assumes one window per batch.
Do not construct windows by nonoverlapping40-frame chunks or use fixed4-overlap tail:100-frame sequence final overlap is16.
Do not resize/pad native NUDT data unless a documented original-loader path requires it (NUDT path does not).
Check filenames and file counts match: source sorts images and masks independently then pairs by array position.
Do not add ROC(0,0)/(1,1) or truncate false-alarm domain.
At threshold1 sigmoid saturation may preserve positive pixels; >= must remain.
Do not silently repair negative slicing at target borders in reproduction; record border cases separately.
Call original ShootingRules and writeNUDTMIRSDT_ROC; adapter may supply validated tensors/counts, but disclose adapter.
Official code writes logs into checkpoint folder; use isolated log destination to preserve source checkout.
torch2.7 weights-only checkpoint loading may need narrowly allowlisted NumPy metadata; do not alter tensor weights.
Source log metrics are targets, not proof of local reproduction or checkpoint training seed.
Seed46 explicit runtime fixing is allowed by user; official entrypoints do not prove author checkpoint used46.
